pool.text: Tenochtitlan was established by the Mexica people on islands in Lake Texcoco.
Spanish explorer Hernán Cortés arrived in Tenochtitlan with native allies.
Aztecs rose up against the Spanish intrusion during La Noche Triste.
Cuauhtémoc surrendered after a siege, and the city was nearly destroyed.
The municipality of Mexico City was established as México Tenochtitlán.
Mexico's independence from Spain was declared in the Mexican Empire declaration.
Leon Trotsky was initially granted asylum and finally murdered in Coyoacán.
Jack Kerouac wrote his famous masterpiece volume of poetry in the city.
The Olympic Games brought about the construction of large sporting facilities.
The Mexico City Metro was inaugurated to provide public transportation.
Mexico City was split into four different delegaciones, increasing the total number.
The Sala Nezahualcóyotl opened as the first wrap-around concert hall.
The Templo Mayor was discovered while workers were digging trenches.
Half of all industrial jobs in Mexico were located in the city.
The area was struck by a powerful earthquake in the morning hours.
An amendment stated Mexico City and the Federal District were the same entity.
Residents won the right to elect the head of government and assembly members.
A specific civic facility was inaugurated on the second day of February.
Local authorities for boroughs were first elected directly by plurality.
The restaurant Sud 777 was placed on the World's Best Restaurants list.
